text:
Raj Nair: Quick check — SFO2 cutover for privacy-sensitive EU customers: we discovered the residency checkbox is not being honored by the edge proxy for some flows. Possible 48h impact if we need a hotfix. Who can own triage?
Amanda Li: Oof. Which flows exactly? embeddings or streaming generation?
Raj Nair: Both. Looks like streaming calls with plugin routing fall back to default egress unexpectedly. repro steps incoming.
Chris Ortega: I can take triage for proxy side. pinging infra-sre for priority.
Marta Kovacs: FYI cust legal flagged this — need written timeline before we tell them. Can we do a scoped rollback if fix is risky?
Devon Blake: @Chris can you confirm if the canary for sfo2 had residency flag set? My quick grep shows a missing header mapping in the envoy filter.
Chris Ortega: Good call — I see the filter config in canary1 differs: header map for X-Residency is absent.
Chris Ortega: minimal patch: add mapping + unit test, redeploy filter. low risk.
infra-bot: deploy-preview: canary1-proxy v3 -> success (sha: a1b2c3). see https://ci.internal/reports/2923456789
Raj Nair: Chris, estimate to cut a patch and roll to canary?
Chris Ortega: ~2 hours to code + test, 30-45m to validate on canary, then can push to prod if green.
Marta Kovacs: Please capture the test plan. Legal wants confirmation that no EU data egressed in last 24h.
Amanda Li: I'll run a quick query against access logs for last 24h and flag any egress hits.
Devon Blake: For visibility, here's the minimal change I think we need to add to envoy filter:
```
- headers_to_add: []
+ headers_to_add:
+   - key: "x-residency"
+     value_from: request_context.residency
```

Devon Blake: I'll open the PR with the snippet and basic unit test. Assigning to @Chris for review.
Chris Ortega: Reviewing now. Will comment on the PR with any test gaps.
infra-bot: incident-note: severity-medium, tag=region-residency, ticket=INC-7921
Raj Nair: Action items: 1) Chris — code + canary (ETA ~2.5h). 2) Amanda — logs audit (ETA 1h). 3) Marta — communication draft for legal (ETA 2h). 4) Devon — PR + tests (ETA 1.5h).
Marta Kovacs: I'll prepare the legal note and wait for Amanda's audit before sending.
Amanda Li: quick update — logs query running, will post results in this thread.
Chris Ortega: Can someone tag the dedicated-account team? we might need to update routing policy if any dedicated pools were affected. @Raj?
Raj Nair: tagging now: @dedicated-account (cc: product-ops).
Devon Blake: PR opened: https://git.internal/edge/proxy/pulls/431. tests included. please review.
Chris Ortega: LGTM with one nit. merging after CI.
infra-bot: CI: edge-proxy-tests passed (all). merge: PR 431 -> main (sha: d4e5f6).
Chris Ortega: Canary deployed, monitoring for 30m.
Amanda Li: Logs audit: no confirmed EU egress hits in last 24h for affected flows. will attach query output to the ticket.
Marta Kovacs: Good — drafting legal note now.
Raj Nair: Thanks everyone. If canary stays green at +30m we proceed to prod push. Please update INC-7921 with status. :thumbsup:
Devon Blake: noted, I'll update the ticket and add links to PR + deploy.
Chris Ortega: Canary +30m healthy. scheduling prod roll in 15m.
infra-bot: deploy: main -> prod (edge-proxy) started by chris.eta=15m
Raj Nair: final: communicate to customers once prod is green. I'll coordinate messaging with Marta.
Marta Kovacs: Will send internal draft first, then external after prod success.
infra-bot: deploy: main -> prod complete (success).
Raj Nair: Prod confirm — residency enforcement working on spot checks. Closing loop here, great cross-team response.
Amanda Li: attaching logs snapshot to INC-7921.
Devon Blake: closing PR followups and adding postmortem checklist item to region-runbook.
Marta Kovacs: legal note queued to send on prod confirmation.
Raj Nair: :tada: thanks all, good catch and quick fix.
